༄༅/ /rnam sras sku bzhengs tshul bzhugs so/ /oṃ swā sti/gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang sogs chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/rdo rje 'cha

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam sras sku bzhengs tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swā sti/ gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang sogs chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha che rin chen rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha che dgon pa ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo chen 'phags pa shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yor po jo ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje bsod nams rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje padma bkra shis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rje jo bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo chen byams pa dpal bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo chen sems dpa' chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rin chen seṅge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen rin chen grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo chen rin chen rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje nam mkha' mchog grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rin chen dpal grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rin chen mchog grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rin chen 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ /ser chen lha dgu stod lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ lo chen 'phags pa shes rab yan gong bzhin la/ chos rje blo gros grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje mgon po yon tan la phyag 'tshal lo/

/chos rje lung khu dgon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje mkhan po lung ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje legs pa'i shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje byang chub rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje byang chub gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje blo bzang dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje blo bzang grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje shākya blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rdo rje rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen man gong dang 'dra/ ༈ /yang ser can smad lugs dang / /drod byed zhon pa med pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka ma ru pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka hna pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon rin chen rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha che sardza na la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha che te dza de wa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo tsā 'phags pa shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhu sa skya pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun grags pa seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya ston sgrub pa po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya ston grub mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rdo rje dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro phu sems dpa' chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang rtse rin chen seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu ston man phyag rdor dang 'dra/ ༈ /be con can gyi brgyud pa ni/ lo chen byams pa dpal yan phyag rdor ltar la/ mkhan chen dbang phyug grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson 'grus byang chub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos grags dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ shākya ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun dga' tshe 'phel la phyag 'tshal lo/

/shākya rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rin chen 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /yang rta sngon can/ ma mo ltar sgrub pa seng zhon/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa/ mdung dmar can/ srin po bzhis bskor/ rnam sras mthing kha/ mdung dmar can la phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ gar mkhan mchog gnyis/ dkar po tshe 'phel rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon mdzad chos kyi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal 'gro bzang snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bhriṃ ke ra wa ti la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha che dgon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo tsā 'phags pa shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yor po jo ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems dpa' rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson 'grus dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan tshul khrims la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo bzang grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya mchog ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun dga' tshe 'phel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /ser can sprin gseb ma'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha sras mu tig btsan po la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhang lha bzang klu dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen kun dga' sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rabs byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /yang de nas brgyud pa'i mdung dmar can gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bai ro tsa na la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yu sgra snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khri srong lde'u btsan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma shes rab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbus pa dmar ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon gcur ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od zer bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzñā na kṣa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun rgyas mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rin chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dpal ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos grub seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun dga' rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dbang bkra shis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen man sprin gseb ma'i brgyud pa bzhin no/

༈ /gnubs lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po kun skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bha su dha ra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdong ring la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsug tor 'gying ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po tsa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam po dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser po ldang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i gying la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ra thung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso bo lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo phan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshar chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don grub rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang phyug rab brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag dbang chos grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man gong ltar te/ phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi sngags/ tadya thā/ bha bho sannā ga a dhi pa te/ i daṃ nī lāṃ ba ra rda ra sha rī raṃ/ badzra pa ṇi hrī da yaṃ/ yaḥs ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ku lota pā da na bha bi ṣya ti/ tadya thā/ buddha buddha/ bi buddha/ mā ti pra ma tha/ ha ra ha ra nā ga nāṃ/ pra hā ra ha ra nā ga nāṃ/ tstshindha tstshindha nā ga hṝ da yā ni/ bhindha bhindha nā ga marmā ṇi/ bi shātyaṃ tu nā ga sha ri rā ṇi/ bi spho ṭa ya nā ga nā ya nā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ tadya thā/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ na go ta pā da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nī la ba pa nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ta ha ta ba la pa ra kra mā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kri tantā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kṛ tantā ru pā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

trā pa nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ku smā ḍa to pa da nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yakṣa a sasmā ra bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha ra ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarb+ba bighnan bi nā sha ka ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha truṃ saṃ ga bi nā sha ka ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ bar gzungs la rnam sras srog 'khor/ 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ bai3/ 'dab ma re re la bai3/ bzhi bzhi/ lte ba'i bai3/ yi ge shar du/ oṃ/ lhor/ bai3/ nub tu/ swā/ byang du hā/ rdo rje'i g.yas ngos su oṃ shra ma nā ye/ nor bu lugs su brtsegs pa/ g.yon du a tha kha thaṃ/ nor bu lugs su brtsegs pa'i mu khyud la oṃ bai3 shra wa na ye hūm̐/ yig mgo phyir bstan/ 'dab ma'i mu khyud nang ma la/ mdun nas g.yas bskor yig mgo phyir bstan gyi/ tadya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e hye hi/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ sarba artha me sā dhā ya/ tadya thā/ su dha ne su ra ṇi/ sa ma ti/ su pu ṣe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ dpal chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras btsun mo sras dang blon po 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sa skya pa kun blo dang / mthu stobs dbang phyug mi brgyud chos brgyud 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad sel/ mthun rkyen thams cad spel/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ gdug pa can thal bar rlog rje btsun sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/

de'i phyi'i mu khyud la mgo bstan phyogs dang bskor tshul gong bzhin gyi/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e āai/ o āau/ aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ dpal chos skyong ba'i sogs gong bzhin/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ yig mgo dang bskor tshul gong bzhin gyi/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunteṣanta/ ta thā ga ta hya wa data te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa/ dpal chos skyong ba'i sogs gong bzhin/ ༈ /bar gzungs kyi gras rnam sras kyi sngags ni/ tadya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e hye hi/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ sarba artha me/ sa dhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ su dha ne su ra ṇi/ su ma ti/ su su ṣe hi li mi li swāhā/ oṃ bai3 swāhā/ oṃ bai3 shrā ma ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ dzaṃ dzambha la ye swāhā/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la ye swāhā/ oṃ sūṃ suṃ/ purṇaṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ pūrṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ maṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra swāhā/ oṃ kuṃ ku we ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swāhā/ oṃ saṃ saṃ pra dzñā na ye swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dzñā na ye swāhā/ oṃ guṃ gu hasd+ya na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu hasd+ya na ye swāhā/ oṃ paṃ pañtsi ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye swāhā/ oṃ piṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa li ye swāhā/ gser can gtso 'khor gyi sngags/ dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sngags/ oṃ bhrūm̐ ṇi ā yu ṣe swāhā/ oṃ bai phu ta pa ro bi shwa ra bi dza ye swāhā/

oṃ bai shrā wa ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā padma ku la dha ri shaṅka ba su ratna kṣa te nā ga sarba ma ṇi ma nu sma ra swāhā/ rnam sras mthing kha yab yum gtso 'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ba su ka ṣa ba ra ma ṇi dhṛka ya ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ oṃ ba su bha dra purṇa bha dra saṃ bhū ta dzha bha wā kanta ra ṣwe te/ bha wa shwa na dha ra ya swāhā/ oṃ adya a gu li a de wa li phu nā ga li/ ya yakṣa li/ ra rakṣa li/ ya ya ma li/ na ma sarba siddhi ku rū swāhā/ gar mkhan mchog gi sngags ni/ oṃ badzra pa ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ye swāhā/ gar mkhan ma mchog dmar smug yab yum gyi sngags ni/ na ma bai shrā ma ṇa ye nā tha ku we ra ma hā bha bhyo kri ta bhi na bha na dhyi ma ni ba si ti swāhā/ oṃ ma hā padma ku la dha ri shaṅka ba su ratna kṣa te nā ga sarba ma ṇi ma nu sma ra swāhā/ dregs byed seng zhon gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ni laṃ bha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ma hā yakṣa rā dza ku be ra bi tu ra ga si siddhi me pra yatstsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhen pa spangs pa'i dreg byed kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ni laṃ bha ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ma hā yakṣa rā dza ku be ra/ bi rū ṭa ka siddhi me pra yatstsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ /oṃ swasti/ rnam sras kyi sku 'di sa skya pa kun blo mched kyis gdung brgyud rim pa'i gzim chung rten du dmigs nas bzhengs par dbu zhabs bar gsum gyi gzungs spyi 'gro cha tshang dang / khyad par rnam sras chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla brgyud/ dpal sa skya'i gsung rabs/ srog 'khor dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba nas gsung pa bzhin rab gnas dang ldan pa/ g.yang skyabs/ nor lha/ gser 'od/ nor rgyun ma/ rta gzungs/ lug gzungs rnams nas 'byung ba'i sngags byin rlabs can du ma/ 'dod gsol rgyas pa nged rang gis brtsams pa/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs rten sne 'dzoms/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo rdzas ldan sogs mdor na rten 'di nyid ring bsrel rnam pa lnga'i ril gyi gong bu lta bu la/

nged rang mched nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rab gnas nan tan dang / rgyun bskang gi dmigs rten bcas pas byin rlabs can yin nges la rjes 'jug rnams kyi 'jim sku ras su bor ba'i bsam med dang gdan sa chen po brgyud bcas la them med kyi gzhan du 'khyar ba sogs bya mi chog cing / gal te yi ge 'di la'ang brtsi med shar tshe sa skya pa la 'go zhing 'ches pa'i bstan srung rgya mtshos gdug pa can de'i lus sems dbyings su phrol la ma 'ongs srid pa'i rgyun kyang bcad de rtag mtshan mngon sum du ma btang na 'dis mtshon pa'i gdan sa chen po'i byin rten rnams phyir 'khyar kho na yong nges su 'dug pas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgo dran par mdzod la 'di don 'bad med du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// //maṅga laṃ/ /zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rnam sras sku bzhengs tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
